title: 一个人有必要建立自己的个人品牌吗？
summary: 在以前，一个普通人想让更多人认识自己，其实很难。你认识谁、在哪里工作、在哪家公司， 很大程度上决定了别人能不能认识你。但现在不一样了。自媒体让每个人都有了可以触达世界的机会。
title_en: Does an ordinary person need a personal brand?
summary_en: It used to be genuinely hard for an ordinary person to be seen — who you knew, where you worked, which company you were at, largely decided whether anyone could know you. But that's no longer the case. Social media gives everyone a way to reach the world.

title: 即使没人看见，我也愿意做。因为创作本身，就让我感到充实。
summary: 我一直很害怕一件事情。有一天突然回头，发现自己这一年和上一年没有什么区别。做着一样的工作，过着一样的生活，认识一样的人，甚至连自己想要什么，都已经懒得再想。我好像一直在逃离这种状态。
title_en: Even if no one is watching, I'd still do it. The act of creating itself feels fulfilling.
summary_en: I've always feared one thing: suddenly looking back and finding this year no different from the last — same work, same life, same people, too lazy to even think about what I actually want. I've been running from that state my whole life.
